```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)

source("src/wikipedia-tools.R")
source("src/gh-copy-assets.R")

muni_lookup  <- readRDS(here::here("data", "muni_id_lookup_table.rds"))
concejo_data <- readRDS(here::here("data", "oep2026", "muni_concejo_comb.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| include: false

# Renders a wikitext copy block (button + visible pre + hidden textarea)
wikitext_block <- function(id, label, content) {
  tagList(
    tags$button(
      class = "copy-btn",
      style = "margin-bottom: 6px;",
      onclick = sprintf("copyTableToClipboard('%s', this)", id),
      label
    ),
    tags$pre(
      tags$code(content),
      style = paste(
        "background-color: #f6f8fa; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px;",
        "overflow-x: auto; font-size: 11px; white-space: pre; margin: 0;"
      )
    ),
    tags$textarea(
      id = id,
      style = "position: absolute; left: -9999px; height: 0; width: 0; overflow: hidden;",
      readonly = TRUE,
      content
    )
  )
}

# Renders a collapsible <details> block for one municipality.
# Left panel: English kable preview. Right panel: Spanish wikitext + copy button.
muni_block <- function(id_muni, muni_name, department, council_wikitext, concejo) {
  kbl <- build_council_kable_en(id_muni, data = concejo)

  tagList(
    tags$details(
      tags$summary(
        tags$strong(muni_name),
        tags$span(
          paste0(" \u2014 ", department),
          style = "color: #586069; font-weight: normal;"
        ),
        tags$code(
          paste0(" [", id_muni, "]"),
          style = "font-size: 11px; color: #999; margin-left: 6px;"
        )
      ),
      tags$div(
        style = "display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start; margin-top:8px; font-size:12px;",
        tags$div(style = "flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; overflow-x:auto;", kbl),
        tags$div(
          style = "flex:1 1 0; min-width:0;",
          wikitext_block(
            id      = paste0("concejo_", id_muni),
            label   = "Copiar tabla del concejo",
            content = council_wikitext
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    tags$hr(style = "border:none; border-top:1px solid #e1e4e8; margin:4px 0;")
  )
}

# Renders all municipality blocks sorted by id_muni
render_muni_blocks <- function(lookup, concejo) {
  ids <- lookup |>
    filter(id_muni %in% unique(concejo$id_muni)) |>
    arrange(id_muni) |>
    select(id_muni, muni_anexo, department)

  blocks <- pmap(ids, function(id_muni, muni_anexo, department) {
    wt <- build_council_wikitable_es(id_muni, data = concejo)
    muni_block(id_muni, muni_anexo, department, wt, concejo)
  })

  tagList(blocks)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: assets
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
include_table_assets()
```

```{r}
#| label: council-tables
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_muni_blocks(muni_lookup, concejo_data)
```
